summary: Summer of Bitcoin is a global, online summer internship that introduces university students to bitcoin open source development and design. Students spend 12 weeks contributing to an open source bitcoin project and earn bitcoin as their stipend.

stipend.detail: Set by location (where your university is and/or where you live during the project) using Purchasing Power Parity. Amounts are in USD and paid in the equivalent amount of bitcoin (BTC) at the price on the day of payment.
stipend.tableNote: Stipend for your country (USD, paid in bitcoin).

facts.label: Before the internship
facts.value: A challenge round bootcamp, then a project proposal

eligibility: A student enrolled in a university or high school program.
Able to communicate clearly and respectfully in English.
Strong programming or design skills and experience with open source; Git experience for the developer track.
Available to work full-time for the 12 summer weeks, with no other job or major commitments.
Good internet connectivity and able to stay in regular contact with mentors.
howToApply: Apply on summerofbitcoin.org to the developer or designer track.
Qualified applicants join the challenge round bootcamp and solve weekly challenges.
Pick a project idea from a participating organization and submit a proposal on the Summer of Bitcoin portal.
Selection is based on the proposal, the bootcamp challenges and contributions to the project.
